You will help ensure data transfers with other state agencies and parties happen on time. Working across BATCH, ONLINE, and WEB environments, you will share responsibility for developing, modifying, testing, and maintaining complex programs and systems. You will also work alongside application database administrators and other programming staff to troubleshoot and resolve problems. You will help evaluate and recommend new system software or tools, and support agency users in testing system enhancements or new implementations. You will assist in preparing system documentation and user training materials as requested by management, and help train staff. You will attend meetings, training, conferences, seminars, and webinars as requested by management. You will participate as a project lead as needed, coordinate task assignments, and contribute input on personnel actions.
cond_0198.requirements:

Two years of full-time or equivalent part-time paid computer programming experience in one or more programming or data base languages, including one year of analysis work.

cond_0296.responsibilities:
Drive the design, development, modification, testing, implementation, and maintenance of complex computer programs and systems in BATCH, ONLINE, and WEB environments.
Ensure data transfers with other state agencies and/or parties are completed on time.
Lead coordination with applications database administrators and other programming staff to troubleshoot and resolve problems.
Evaluate and recommend new system software or tools; direct testing of system enhancements or new implementations with agency users.
Prepare system documentation and user training materials as requested by management.
Deliver staff training as needed.
Attend meetings, training, conferences, seminars, and/or webinars as requested by management.
Take on project lead responsibilities as needed and assign tasks accordingly.
Provide input on personnel actions.
cond_0296.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in computer science or a related field (including but not limited to business data programming, business systems analysis, computer accounting, computer and information systems, computer servicing technologies, information systems management, data processing, or computer engineering).
OR an Associate's degree in computer science or a related field from an accredited college, university, or business school and eighteen months of full-time or equivalent part-time paid computer programming experience in one or more programming or database languages.
Substitution: Three years of full-time or equivalent part-time paid computer programming experience in one or more programming or database languages may substitute for the required training.
Preferred Requirements
Two years of full-time or equivalent part-time paid computer programming experience in one or more programming or database languages, including one year of analysis work.
